description: Defines the ImportMapOther class which manages import settings and default field mappings for different modules in SuiteCRM, including methods for retrieving mappings and ignored fields.

classes.name: ImportMapOther
classes.description: Class handling import settings, including field mappings for modules like Contacts, Leads, Accounts, and Opportunities.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns default field mappings for a given module.

methods.name: getIgnoredFields
methods.description: Returns list of fields to ignore during import for a given module.
